description: This Java class 'ThingConflictStrategy' implements a conflict handling strategy for 'CreateThing' commands within a persistence layer, specifically managing cases where a 'CreateThing' command is issued for a Thing that already exists, by returning an error result indicating a conflict.

classes.name: ThingConflictStrategy
classes.description: A final class extending AbstractCommandStrategy that handles 'CreateThing' commands by returning conflict errors when a create command conflicts with an existing Thing.

methods.name: ThingConflictStrategy
methods.description: Constructor initializing the strategy with the 'CreateThing' command class.

methods.name: isDefined (CreateThing command)
methods.description: Determines if the command is defined; always returns false in this implementation.

methods.name: isDefined (Context<ThingId> context, @Nullable final Thing thing, final CreateThing command)
methods.description: Checks if the command applies based on context state and command's entity ID.

methods.name: calculateRelativeMetadata(@Nullable final Thing entity, final CreateThing command)
methods.description: Returns empty metadata Optional, indicating no metadata calculation is performed.

methods.name: doApply(final Context<ThingId> context, @Nullable final Thing thing, final long nextRevision, final CreateThing command, @Nullable final Metadata metadata)
methods.description: Executes the strategy: returns an error result indicating a conflict via ThingConflictException.
